title: Staff workspace
brief: Design-only staff dashboard and catalog using existing access and item/restaurant availability capabilities. Warm stone, dark forest ink, system typography, responsive layouts and explicitly fictional bowl/soup/tea fixtures. No live actions or operational claims. Recommend the quiet sidebar for implementation.

artboards.title: Quiet sidebar — recommended
artboards.tradeoff: Persistent navigation and calm item rows give clear orientation and readable availability; the sidebar uses horizontal space and becomes a compact navigation band on mobile.

artboards.title: Compact topbar
artboards.tradeoff: Top navigation frees width for spacious item cards and a prominent restaurant status band; cards are slower to compare and require more scrolling on mobile.

artboards.title: Dense list workbench
artboards.tradeoff: Aligned compact rows favor rapid price and availability comparison with separate restaurant controls; the denser desktop layout has less breathing room and stacks the restaurant panel first on mobile.
